GSK Internship Program - GMS 2017

Requisition ID: 150203
Position: Co-Op
Open date: 07/02/2017 05:04 ص
Functional area: Production
Location:
Jeddah, Makkah
Required degrees: Bachelors
Relocation: Not Indicated
Basic qualifications:
• Must have active student status and / or within 12 months of graduating from a degree program.
• Studying in one of the following fields: Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmacy.
• Good English language fluency.
• Demonstrate academic achievements.
• Good command of MS Office.
• Excellent communication skills, both oral and written.

This internship opportunity will be based in Jeddah Factory (Al Khomrah District).

Preferred qualifications:
• Fluency in English.
• Good problem solving and analytical skills.

Details:
We are a global, science-led healthcare company operating in three main areas; Pharmaceuticals, Vaccines and Consumer Healthcare. Our mission is to improve the quality of human life by enabling people to do more, feel better and live longer.

It’s never easy to decide what you want to do in the future. That’s why we do what we can to give young people a taste of working life to help them make the right choices. We offer a limited number of placements each year that are packed with interesting experiences.

Those successfully completing the program will be considered for full time opportunities based on available opportunities and business needs.
